title: Fix profile edit reliability, improve error handling, reduce splash delay, add admin dark mode
description: Fix profile edit error propagation, improve error messages for handle uniqueness, add fallback for empty trending creators, reduce splash delay, and add dark mode support to the admin app.

findings.environment: Flutter SDK is not installed in the sandbox and network access is restricted. Cannot run flutter analyze or flutter build apk. Changes verified by manual code review only.
changes_summary: error_utils.dart: Added handle uniqueness detection (checks for 'handle' + 'unique'/'duplicate'/'already exists') before generic duplicate check
profile_provider.dart: Added _lastError field and lastError getter to ProfileNotifier; set on catch, cleared on new attempt
edit_profile_screen.dart: On updateProfile failure, reads notifier.lastError and displays via ErrorUtils.sanitize instead of generic message
home_provider.dart: trendingCreatorsProvider falls back to fetching from 'users' table where role='creator' if creator_profiles join is empty
splash_screen.dart: Reduced navigation delay from 1500ms to 800ms (matches animation duration)
admin_app/core/theme/app_theme.dart: Added full darkTheme getter with dark colors matching user app pattern
admin_app/features/settings/providers/settings_provider.dart: Created SettingsState, SettingsNotifier, settingsProvider (same pattern as user app)
admin_app/app.dart: Imported settings provider, added darkTheme and themeMode to MaterialApp.router
